(1) peat-forming regions in the Okefenoee swamp-marsh complex are characterized by peats with distinctive petrographic characteristics, (2) these petrographic characteristics can be used to determine whether a given peat is derived from a particular peat-forming region, and (3) the petrographic characteristics of a given peat can be used to predict the eventual coal composition of that peat.

the micropetrographic composition and texture of peat sediments can be used to identify their original depositional environments, and that the peat types can be used to predict the eventual coal types that will result from peatification.
